title: Living monitor and re-triage
description: Poll a source, deduplicate new records, apply standing criteria, and escalate material changes.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: living-monitor-retriage
  title: Living monitor and re-triage
  description: Poll a source, deduplicate new records, apply standing criteria, and escalate material changes.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Maintain an up-to-date, criteria-filtered view of a changing source.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: retry
    requireApprovalFor:
      - material-change-review
  nodes:
    - id: config
      kind: input
      name: Monitor configuration
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - source
          - cadence
          - criteria
          - knownItems
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: poll
      name: Poll source
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Source monitor
      prompt: Poll the configured source at the declared cadence and return only records observed in the current polling
        window with retrieval timestamps.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: dedupe
      name: Remove known items
      kind: transform
      config:
        operation: deduplicate
    - id: triage
      kind: agent
      name: Apply standing criteria
      role: Triage analyst
      prompt: Evaluate only newly discovered items against the supplied criteria. Mark material changes with evidence.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - classify
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: materiality
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Determine material change
      role: Change evaluator
      prompt: Return passed only when no new item materially changes the current view.
      config:
        threshold: 1
    - id: material-change-review
      kind: approval
      name: Owner reviews material changes
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Updated monitor register and re-triage report
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: config
      to: poll
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: poll
      to: dedupe
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: config
      to: dedupe
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: dedupe
      to: triage
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: triage
      to: materiality
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: materiality
      to: result
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e7
      from: materiality
      to: material-change-review
      kind: control
      condition: failed
    - id: e8
      from: material-change-review
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
